versions.subject: Merge PR #5183 from @swachchhanda000 - add rules for malware abusing grimresource and RTLO techniques
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\conhost.exe'
selection_child:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\cmd.exe'             # Windows Command Prompt
          - '\cscript.exe'         # Windows Script Host (used for scripting exploits)
          - '\mshta.exe'           # MSHTA (HTML Application Host, often abused)
          - '\powershell_ise.exe'  # PowerShell ISE
          - '\powershell.exe'      # Windows PowerShell
          - '\pwsh.exe'            # PowerShell Core
          - '\regsvr32.exe'        # Windows Registry Server (commonly used for exploits)
          - '\wscript.exe'         # Windows Script Host (for executing scripts)
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'cmd.exe'
          - 'cscript.exe'
          - 'mshta.exe'
          - 'powershell_ise.exe'
          - 'powershell.exe'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
          - 'regsvr32.exe'
          - 'wscript.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\conhost.exe" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\mshta.exe", "*\\powershell_ise.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("cmd.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "powershell_ise.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.dll", "regsvr32.exe", "wscript.exe")
